bioconda.name: bioconductor-eopreddata
bioconda.summary: ExperimentHub package containing model data for predicting preeclampsia status for based on plcaental DNA methylation profile
bioconda.description: Provides access to eoPred pretrained model hosted on ExperimentHub. Model was trained on placental DNA methylation preeclampsia samples using mixOmics splsda. There are two resources: 1. the model object, and 2. a testing data set used to demonstrate the function.
